scope: v2 parameter-only autonomous closed loop; v3 repair executors excluded

parameter_policy_primary.hypothesis: At equal full-flow evaluation budget, BO/GP improves balanced relative utility over seeded random.
parameter_policy_primary.replica_randomization: three distinct OR_SEED values derived from the policy seed and paired across policies and vectors
parameter_policy_primary.primary_outcome: best feasible balanced relative utility after three candidate vectors
parameter_policy_primary.infeasible_cell_rule: if baseline and all three candidates lack a feasible complete summary, retain the cell and assign -1.0; otherwise select the largest feasible utility including the zero-utility baseline
parameter_policy_primary.primary_test: two-sided paired sign-flip permutation test over 40 design-seed cells
parameter_policy_primary.interval: seeded nonparametric bootstrap 95% CI for median paired difference
parameter_policy_primary.multiplicity: per-design secondary tests use Holm correction
parameter_policy_primary.exclusions: none after launch; timeout, crash and hard-constraint failures remain failures
parameter_policy_primary.stopping: exactly three candidate vectors after a three-replica baseline

external_validity.source: pinned ORFS multi-file RTL expanded into a content-addressed platform input
external_validity.purpose: cost, compatibility and failure-mode evidence; not pooled with the primary small-design significance test
external_validity.liveness_rule: elapsed wall time alone is not a hang signal; continue while CPU activity or logs/artifacts advance, and stop only at the frozen timeout or on an explicit terminal failure

other_registered_ablations.rtl: independent natural-language attempts; full Verification-Agent plus RTLScout gates versus weaker gate subsets; pass@1/pass@k and GDS-conditioned PPA
other_registered_ablations.learning: all ordered source/holdout design pairs under repeated 2x2 interventions; false-transfer admission of retrieval-only versus causal holdout
other_registered_ablations.edair: frozen factual/statistical/reasoning questions answered from KPI-only versus typed provenance-linked EDAIR
other_registered_ablations.agent: checkpoint recovery, authority, evidence completeness and token/context footprint versus removed components; no unsupported claim that orchestration alone raises QoR

claim_rules: Do not call deterministic identical reruns independent PPA samples.
Do not replace failed or timed-out runs.
Do not claim arbitrary natural-language RTL generalization from the fixed suite.
Do not claim v3 stage-repair capability from a v2 diagnosis trace.
Report effect size, uncertainty and raw run counts together.
